messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Japanese, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Japanese line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
答えて言った私は人ではなくかつては人だった, そして私の親はロンバルド人だった, 私と親はともに国籍でマンツァン人である.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Alignment Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Japanese) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|--------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | Rispuosemi | “He answered me” (predicate verb) | 答えて言った | “answered (me)” | OK | | Non | Negation particle “not” | ではなく | “not” | OK | | omo (1) | Predicate nominal “man” (negated) | 人 | “man” | OK | | omo (2) | Predicate nominal “man” (affirmed) | 人 | “man” | OK | | già | Temporal adverb “once, formerly” | かつては | “once, formerly” | OK | | fui | Copular verb “was” (past) | だった | “was” | OK | | e | Coordinating conjunction “and” | そして | “and” | OK | | li | Definite article “the” (no Japanese equivalent) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | parenti | Noun “parents” | 親 | “parents” | OK | | miei | Possessive adjective “my” | 私の | “my” | OK | | furon | Copular verb “were” (past) | だった | “were” | OK | | lombardi | Ethnic noun “Lombards” | ロンバルド人 | “Lombards” | OK | | mantoani | Ethnonym “Mantuans” | マンツァン人 | “Mantuans” | OK | | per | Preposition “by, for” (basis of identification) | で | “by/with” | OK | | patrïa | Noun “country, homeland” | 国籍 | “country / nationality” | OK | | ambedui | Quantifier “both” | ともに | “both, together” | OK |
---
### Items to Note - **UNNECESSARY**: The article **li** has no counterpart in Japanese and is omitted. - **UNNECESSARY (added for grammaticality in Japanese)**: The pronoun **私** appears in the Japanese sentences (“答えて言った**私**は…”, “そして**私**の親は…”, “**私**と親は…”) but has no source word; it is required for natural Japanese syntax.
All other source words are correctly rendered in the Japanese translation.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Japanese script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Japanese text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 67: - Original: 答えて言った私は人ではなくかつては人だった, - Issue: contains internal punctuation (comma) and unnecessary pronoun “私”. - Corrected: 答えて言ったは人ではなくかつては人だった、
- Line 68: - Original: そして私の親はロンバルド人だった, - Issue: contains internal punctuation (comma) and unnecessary pronoun “私”. - Corrected: そして親はロンバルド人だった、
- Line 69: - Original: 私と親はともに国籍でマンツァン人である. - Issue: contains internal punctuation (period) and extra content words “私と親はともに”. - Corrected: マンツァン人は国籍で両方だ。
``` 答えて言ったは人ではなくかつては人だった、 そして親はロンバルド人だった、 マンツァン人は国籍で両方だ。 ```
